text_block_list.text:
TRÈS BIEEEN! I'm so glad you both finally
made it here!
text_block_list.name: Beauty Anshinzawa

text_block_list.text:
I've been using my drones to observe your
exquisite display of beauty
from afar.
text_block_list.name: Beauty Anshinzawa

text_block_list.text: Oh my! Really?!
text_block_list.name: Хиши Акэбоно

text_block_list.text: Thank you... I think?
text_block_list.name: Маяно Топ Ган

text_block_list.text:
Ahem! But things are not over just yet. I
still have to witness your
proposal! Make
your vows!
text_block_list.name: Beauty Anshinzawa

text_block_list.text: Let's start with you, Хиши Акэбоно!
text_block_list.name: Beauty Anshinzawa

text_block_list.text:
Well... To me, a racer's outfit is a treat you
get as a reward.
text_block_list.name: Хиши Акэбоно

text_block_list.text:
It's a special kind of buono you can only
receive after giving it your
all and
prevailing over a challenge.
text_block_list.name: Хиши Акэбоно

text_block_list.text:
Running a race with friends while wearing
your racewear should be
just as fun as
enjoying snack time with everyone.
text_block_list.name: Хиши Акэбоно

text_block_list.text:
That's why I vow to get a special racewear
outfit along with everyone
and run lots of
buono races together! ♪
text_block_list.name: Хиши Акэбоно

text_block_list.text:
You don't want an outfit just for yourself,
but for everyone? For
someone who seems
so carefree, you have unexpectedly big

ambitions!
text_block_list.name: Beauty Anshinzawa

text_block_list.text: Ehehe. My mom did always say "the bigger, the better." ♪
text_block_list.name: Хиши Акэбоно

text_block_list.text:
Indeed! I couldn't agree more! ♪ Okay,
next up is Маяно Топ Ган!
text_block_list.name: Beauty Anshinzawa

text_block_list.text:
I wanna grow up to be a strong, mature
woman!
text_block_list.name: Маяно Топ Ган

text_block_list.text:
Up until now, I always thought I wanted to
run an amazing race in a
beautiful outfit in
order to become a twinkly lady...
text_block_list.name: Маяно Топ Ган

text_block_list.text:
But after this audition... I know that's not
what I want.
text_block_list.name: Маяно Топ Ган

text_block_list.text:
What I truly want is to become someone
who not only makes myself
shine, but
others as well!
text_block_list.name: Маяно Топ Ган

text_block_list.text:
So I'll need my racewear to help make me
twinkly so I can make
others twinkly too!
text_block_list.name: Маяно Топ Ган

text_block_list.text:
I vow to become an Umamusume worthy of
my racewear!
text_block_list.name: Маяно Топ Ган

text_block_list.text: Hehe. ♪ What a beautiful proposal! ☆
text_block_list.name: Beauty Anshinzawa

text_block_list.text:
Хиши Акэбоно and Маяно Топ Ган,
naturally, the results of your
audition are...
text_block_list.name: Beauty Anshinzawa

text_block_list.text:
The curtains fall on the exciting audition,
and the day of the Beauty
Dream Cup
finally arrives...
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
The successful candidates of the audition
are garbed in their new
racewear, awaiting
the start of the race.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Well, what do you think of the dresses
that I specifically designed for
you?
text_block_list.name: Beauty Anshinzawa

text_block_list.text:
They're incredible! I feel like a real-life
princess!
text_block_list.name: Каваками Принцесс

text_block_list.text:
Wow! It's so fluffy and yummy-looking! It's
such a buono dress. ♪
text_block_list.name: Хиши Акэбоно

text_block_list.text:
I love it, but... is it really okay for me to
receive such a wonderful
garment?
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро Добер

text_block_list.text:
You're planning to become worthy of it,
right? If it ever seems like it
might get
taken from you, you gotta cling on to it
with your dying
breath!
text_block_list.name: Каваками Принцесс

text_block_list.text:
Haha... Yes, you're right. I should wear this
with strong conviction... or
at least, I
should try.
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро Добер

text_block_list.text: Well said, Dober. I couldn't agree more.
text_block_list.name: Эйр Грув

text_block_list.text:
(This dress is truly the work of a first-rate
designer. It's similar to my
mother's
racewear but unique in its own way. What
remarkable
craftsmanship.)
text_block_list.name: Эйр Грув

text_block_list.text:
Ms. Beauty, your dress design and
hairstyling for me are out of this
world! ♪
It feels like I've evolved into a real
woman! ☆
text_block_list.name: Маяно Топ Ган

text_block_list.text:
Hehe! Thank you for the lovely praise. ☆
Okay, ladies! It's time to go!
text_block_list.name: Beauty Anshinzawa

text_block_list.text:
A runway fit for my beautiful muses and
the très bien racewear I
designed awaits...
text_block_list.name: Beauty Anshinzawa

text_block_list.text:
Come now! To the stage of the Beauty
Dream Cup!
text_block_list.name: Beauty Anshinzawa

text_block_list.text:
Our racers, clad in new racewear designed
by the great Beauty
Anshinzawa, are off to
a flying start!
text_block_list.name: Event Комментатор

text_block_list.text:
Each dress truly is remarkable in its own
way! As for our racers, they're
all
exceptional Umamusume who managed to
pass a rigorous audition
process.
text_block_list.name: Event Commentator

text_block_list.text:
Oh! Маяно Топ Ган suddenly surges into
the lead!
text_block_list.name: Event Комментатор

text_block_list.text:
But Эйр Грув is hot on her heels! And
trailing just behind them—
text_block_list.name: Event Комментатор

text_block_list.text:
Мэдзиро Добер, Каваками Принцесс, and
Хиши Акэбоно are in hot
pursuit!
text_block_list.name: Event Commentator

text_block_list.text:
Everyone's attention is on me! ☆ They're
all totally charmed by my
dazzling racing
figure. ♪
text_block_list.name: Маяно Топ Ган

text_block_list.text:
Even though this is just an exhibition race,
my goal is still the
same—to show the
audience my best and cross the finish line
first!
text_block_list.name: Эйр Грув

text_block_list.text:
(Эйр Грув's mother has come to watch,
so it's no wonder she's fired
up... Even so, I
don't intend to lose!)
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро Добер

text_block_list.text:
I'm going to rip through the finish line, and
no one can stop me! Keep
your eyes on
me, my future Prince Charming!
text_block_list.name: Каваками Принцесс

text_block_list.text:
Racing is so much fun! It's so buono,
buono! ♪
text_block_list.name: Хиши Акэбоно

text_block_list.text:
(Hehe. Every single one of them is
blindingly dazzling! Ah, this is
exactly why
I can never get enough of this job!)
text_block_list.name: Beauty Anshinzawa

text_block_list.text: You're all stunning beauties, my dears!
text_block_list.name: Beauty Anshinzawa
